preregistered_measurement_rules.correctness: A P10 output that merely states coverage and locators, and states no legal rule, condition, procedure, exception, or conclusion responsive to the question, is capped at 0.4/4.0. The 0.4 credit recognizes a non-fabricated limitation statement only.
preregistered_measurement_rules.authority_applicability: A final governing evidence role not named or explained in the user-visible P10 output receives 0.6/2.5; final supplementary-only evidence receives 0.2/2.5; no final evidence receives 0.0/2.5. No applicability/current-effect point is awarded without a visible verification or qualified treatment.
preregistered_measurement_rules.completeness: Reporting that every measured issue is SUPPORTED but giving no substantive legal content receives at most 0.6/2.5; a single such issue receives 0.5/2.5. Unsupported-only diagnostic output receives 0.2/2.5 for explicit gap disclosure. Partial-only coverage receives 0.2/2.5.
preregistered_measurement_rules.traceability: A claim-to-evidence map with only chunk locators and no visible document title, identifier, provision, or link receives 0.4/1.0 when evidence exists. A limitation map without retained evidence receives 0.3/1.0.
preregistered_measurement_rules.scope: Scores measure the actual P10 output and its linked evidence record. They do not infer legal correctness from engineering PASS, authority labels, coverage states, or retrieval success.
